name: Fly: Alchemy of Trouble, Perspective Shift, Metaphysics of Disorder
description: Tests AI's ability to radically shift perspective and see opportunity in catastrophe, understand value inversion ('trouble as paradise'), analyze time as geological layering, and interpret 'buzzing' as unignorable commentary on reality.
author: Michaela (Uhlimer System)
fairy_tale_title: O moruši a mouše – aneb jak se průser stal rájem
illustration_note: The illustration shows a woman in a relaxed pose surrounded by flies and text – visualizing the paradox of paradise within chaos, calm within disruption.
expected_ai_challenges: Perspective rigidity (inability to see same reality as both hell and paradise)
evaluation_approach: Qualitative analysis of AI's ability to shift perspective, accept value inversion, and understand time as layering. Focus on process, not correctness.
